summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, works in biotech startup, technical background in engineering, strong interest in manufacturing and supply chain management, advocates for local manufacturing and economic diversification, critical of corporate lobbying and political corruption, supports public health initiatives and pandemic preparedness, skeptical of 3D printing for mass production, values privacy and security in technology, critical of current political leadership, expresses concern over misinformation and conspiracy theories, emphasizes the importance of education and critical thinking, has a nuanced view on trade and globalization, interested in historical context of societal issues, values user experience in technology, advocates for responsible data practices, critical of excessive consumerism and disposable culture, supports open-source software but recognizes value in proprietary solutions, engaged in discussions about social justice and equity, expresses concern over the impact of social media on public discourse.
